about_the_game:
Interrogate. Investigate. Judge.

In Civil Purgatory, you are a state officer tasked with evaluating detained civilians under a totalitarian regime. Each day, you'll receive a new case file with photographs, documents, intelligence reports, and confiscated items — from personal belongings to weapons and valuables.

Real-Time AI-Generated Dialogue

Every interrogation is powered by artificial intelligence, generating unique, unscripted conversations for each case. Civilians respond differently depending on your tone, pressure, and strategy — offering a dynamic and immersive experience every time.

Search, Analyze, and Report

You can order a patrol unit to search the suspect’s home. Their findings — hidden items, incriminating objects, or personal clues — may become vital in your investigation. You must connect the dots, identify inconsistencies, and support your judgment with evidence.

Confiscate. Appraise. Profit.

Your inventory can include weapons, valuables, or personal effects. Some can be appraised and sold between shifts to cover your daily expenses. But every action has ethical weight — and you are being evaluated constantly.

Your Report Matters

At the end of each case, write a formal justification for your decision. Was the civilian guilty or innocent? Your logic and clarity will be reviewed by an AI system. Promotions, salary, and progression depend on the strength of your conclusions.

Time is Limited

A working digital clock tracks your shift. When the alarm sounds, your day ends — regardless of progress. Manage your time wisely: interrogate, investigate, write… or leave tasks unfinished.

Endless Judgement

This game has no ending. Play indefinitely with randomized civilians, increasingly complex scenarios, and persistent evaluation of your actions.

Features

  • AI-generated conversations with real-time responses
  • Photographs, ID documents, and intelligence reports
  • Personal, valuable, and illegal items to analyze
  • Home searches conducted by patrol divisions
  • Appraisal and item selling system between shifts
  • Written reports reviewed and scored by AI
  • Promotion system and evolving salary
  • Shift time management with digital clock and alarm
  • Pixel art visuals and oppressive atmosphere
  • Endless mode with unlimited replayability

Will you follow orders… or your conscience?

Every civilian has a story. Every object has meaning. Every judgment is yours alone.
Welcome to Civil Purgatory.

content_descriptors.notes: Civil Purgatory is a dystopian world where suspects are subjected to interrogation and may experience physical or verbal abuse. These suspects can belong to marginalized minority groups within the regime and may be imprisoned or implied to be sent to concentration camps. The game explores moral dilemmas such as stealing, discarding, or confiscating their personal belongings.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 Bits)
  • Processor: AMD FX-8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: MSI Radeon R7 200 Series
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Highly recommended: CUDA Toolkit (Increase the Ai response time), Internet required to download the ai model (First time)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 Bits)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or upper
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Highly recommended: CUDA Toolkit (Increase the Ai response time), Internet required to download the ai model (First time)

short_description: Interrogate, investigate, and judge in an authoritarian regime. In Civil Purgatory, real-time AI-generated dialogue adds depth and dynamism to this narrative simulation full of moral dilemmas, where you decide who walks free… and who doesn’t.
